_about: Public-domain Richard Fiddes, Church of England divine and rector of Halsham in Holderness, for the Word Hoard: Theologia Speculativa, Practical Discourses and Fifty-Two Practical Discourses, The Doctrine of a Future State, A General Treatise of Morality, his letter to a free-thinker, his Life of Cardinal Wolsey, and his sermons of 1703 to 1715. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 134 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

_excluded.fiddes-homer: the prefatory epistle on Homer's Iliad is literary
